Name: SlimeNameTags
Author: Chalyb
Description:
[b]About this mod[/b]
slimeNameTags gives every newly spawned slime a parchment-style floating name tag using bacterial genus names (focused on Pseudomonadota).
It is a lightweight immersion/fun mod with a “fight the pathogens” flavor: identify your target, then go clean up the mines.
This project started as a personal comfort mod while being sick, and turned into a polished little gameplay flavor add-on.
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Random bacterial genus name assigned to each slime[/*]
[*]Name displayed as an in-world parchment label[/*]
[*]Stardew-style text look for visual consistency[/*]
[*]Works in normal gameplay areas with slime spawns[/*]
[*]Cosmetic only (no balance/stat/loot changes)[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI (required)[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+ (recommended/current target)[/*]
[/list][b]Not required[/b]
[list]
[*]Content Patcher is [b]not[/b] required[/*]
[*]GMCM is [b]not[/b] required[/*]
[*]Harmony configuration by users is [b]not[/b] required[/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Drop the slimeNameTags folder into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Configuration[/b]
No config menu needed.
Names are loaded from the included names list file.
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Safe for existing saves[/*]
[*]Works alongside most gameplay/content mods[/*]
[*]Purely visual runtime behavior[/*]
[/list][b]Technical notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Implemented as a SMAPI C# mod[/*]
[*]Runtime slime detection + name assignment[/*]
[*]In-world rendering with edge handling for label placement[/*]
[/list][b]Credits[/b]
[list]
[*]Concept, direction, and data curation: Chalyb[/*]
[*]Development support: GitHub Copilot[/*]
[/list][b]Known limitations[/b]
Name labels are intentionally rendered as a visual overlay for readability and style.
In crowded scenes, occasional overlap with entities can still occur due to Stardew’s rendering constraints and UI-style text drawing behavior.
